title: Find the weak spots in our testing
statement: As a product manager, I can list where our testing is weakest, so we can decide where the next test is worth writing.
overview: Proposed addition, as the first of the QA tools. It leaves the decision about what to fix with the team.

acceptance_criteria.statement: It lists criteria with only positive coverage.
It lists criteria and stories with no test at all, and those with no end-to-end test.
It lists catalog entries that verify no criterion.
It lists entries whose code or criterion link is stale.
Each list is grouped by feature, comes with `--json`, fails nothing, and says nothing about which gap matters most.
